external_source: QRData learning_mindset.csv (Causal Inference for the Brave and True, ch.11), gold estimate (CC BY-NC 4.0, xxxiaol/QRData) — external anchor, no GADS recipe pinned (drafted lane by design)

local_attempt.note: Local produced an ATE via gads_causal_estimate_ate using ONLY `success_expect` as a confounder — 1 of the ~9 available covariates (ignoring all school-level variables: school_mindset, school_achievement, school_urbanicity, school_poverty, school_size, plus student ethnicity/gender/first_in_family). Result: 0.3347, noticeably lower than both cloud's 0.3925 and the gold's 0.39. A robustness/sensitivity step (index out of bounds, size 0) also failed and was never recovered. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, AIPW/Doubly-Robust with logistic-regression propensity scores): ATE = 0.3925 (95% CI [0.3583, 0.4268]), matching QRData's gold (0.39) to the reported precision. Corroborated within the same run by an independent LinearDML estimate of 0.3955 (95% CI [0.3605, 0.4304]) — two different estimators agreeing tightly, unprompted.

linear_dml_estimate.note: LinearDML ATE from the same reference run, corroborating the AIPW estimate above. No external gold targets this specific estimator; recorded because the drafted plan produced it unprompted as a robustness cross-check.
